testInfrastructureCorrections.detail: Initial synthetic expectations included fields the existing stored snapshot intentionally omits and an incorrect existing failure message; aligned against the old implementation before accepted baseline.
Replaced unsupported Array.findLastIndex with equivalent map/lastIndexOf, retaining assertions.
Bound original attempt methods through object/arrow receivers instead of passing unbound methods; no lint suppression.
Added the existing FalUsage.endpointId required field to the new provenance fixture.
Removed an unnecessary array spread passed to Set in the new Studio test; expected identities and counts retained.

boundaries: Real createStudioAssets, quote/specification/capability checks, preflight wrappers and generated-assets local D1; wallet, rights/compliance, configuration read and dispatch explicitly stubbed.
Provenance regression runs real parent runImpl, recordProvenance, hashing and scoped D1 writes; generation result, wallet, landing and realtime explicitly stubbed.
G10 original audit remains before-state evidence; it is not rewritten after the provider repair.
